_comment: Tier-2 for sparta particle_emission: emitting on ONE face of an outflow box does not hold the domain at the freestream — and the catalog was WRONG about how you detect it. Four decks differing in one line were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial): a seeded 2d argon box emitting on xlo only, the same box emitting on xlo+ylo+yhi, the same box with no emit fix, and the xlo-only box with the mixture's vstream set to 0. Both particle_emission:2 and hypersonic_flow:1 said the Np column 'decreases monotonically instead of levelling off' and told the reader to check that Np has flattened. Executed, the xlo-only Np column FLATTENS — it falls 28 % over the first stats interval and then changes by 0.2 % over the last, holding at a bit under 60 % of the seeded count. So the recommended check PASSES on the broken deck. Both entries were rewritten in the same commit to the comparison this script actually makes: against a deck emitting on every inflow face, which holds within a couple of percent of the seeded count, while the no-emit deck drains to under 5 %. vstream 0 still emits and plateaus several times lower than the drift case, which is particle_emission:3. Every assertion is a ratio between decks in this script; no measured number is pinned. COVERS: particle_emission:2, particle_emission:3, hypersonic_flow:1.
